title: Universal Machine Rule Schema
description: The absolute essence of a machine-readable rule. Includes lifecycle, dependencies, and provenance. Completely open and context-free.

version.description: Version of this specific rule dataset.

metadata.description: Completely open container for any context (e.g., { 'jurisdiction': 'EU', 'project': 'Apollo' }).

rules.description: The list of directives. Each item is a rule or standard.

type.description: Free text classification (obligation, prohibition, permission, standard, etc.).

message.description: The human-readable output or description of the rule.

target.description: Who or what this rule applies to (e.g., 'Drivers', 'Python-Scripts', 'All-Citizens').

anchor_ref.description: Link back to the human document (e.g., 'section:preamble').

depends_on.description: IDs of rules that must be evaluated or active before this one.

conflicts_with.description: IDs of rules that this rule cannot coexist with.

expires_at.description: Timestamp after which this rule is obsolete.

parameters.description: Unconstrained key-value store for config (pattern, max_length, tax_rate, quorum).
